tokens.name: ink-000
tokens.usage: Absolute white point. Used only as a component of rgba() glass/highlight values, never as a surface on its own.

tokens.name: ink-050
tokens.usage: Light-theme page and neumorphic base surface. Also the light-theme text color on dark fills.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Light-theme hairline dividers and the cover's relief tint block.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled-state content only; not for body text (below 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Faint icons and inactive control marks.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Muted secondary text on ink-050 / ink-000 (7:1+).

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Structural lines and icon strokes in Concept A's instrument grid.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text on light surfaces (light theme).

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Dark-theme page and neumorphic base surface. Also the text color on light/bright fills.

tokens.name: indigo-300
tokens.usage: Concept A (Instrument) accent fill in dark theme; pairs with ink-950 text (7.8:1).

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Concept A (Instrument) primary accent fill in light theme; pairs with ink-000 text (5.1:1). Also Lucent's locked primary accent.

tokens.name: indigo-700
tokens.usage: Concept A accent text/icon color directly on ink-050 (5:1+); also the light-theme focus alternative for indigo contexts.

tokens.name: indigo-900
tokens.usage: Concept A deep shadow tint for pressed states and glass tints over indigo panels.

tokens.name: cyan-300
tokens.usage: Concept B (Atrium) accent fill in dark theme, pairs with ink-950 text (12.9:1); dark-theme focus ring.

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Concept B (Atrium) primary accent fill in light theme; pairs with ink-950 text, not white (8:1).

tokens.name: cyan-700
tokens.usage: Light-theme focus ring on ink-050 / ink-000 (4.6:1); Concept B deep accent text on light glass.

tokens.name: cyan-900
tokens.usage: Concept B deep shadow tint for pressed states and glass tints over cyan panels.

tokens.name: violet-300
tokens.usage: Concept C (Aurora Console) accent fill in dark theme, pairs with ink-950 text (9.6:1).

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Concept C decorative glow, large icons and borders only (3.8:1) — not for small text or fills carrying body copy.

tokens.name: violet-700
tokens.usage: Concept C primary accent fill for buttons and labels in light theme; pairs with ink-000 text (8:1).

tokens.name: violet-900
tokens.usage: Concept C deep shadow tint and glass tints over violet panels.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Page background. Neumorphic raised, control, field and sunken surfaces step at most 4% lightness from this value; elevation reads through shadow tokens plus that small fill step, never a large fill change.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Neumorphic raised panels, cards and buttons. Small fill step (<=4% lightness) above surface-base. Pair with shadow-raised-md (or shadow.neu-raised for legacy).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Neumorphic wells: track grooves and pressed states. Small fill step below surface-base. Pair with shadow-inset (or shadow.neu-inset for legacy).

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Rest fill for neumorphic controls (buttons, toggles, segmented controls). Pair with shadow-raised-md at rest, shadow-raised-hover on hover, shadow-inset when pressed.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Recessed field and well fill for inputs and wells. Pair with shadow-inset-soft. Add a 1px boundary border for 3:1 contrast (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text input fill. Pair with shadow-inset-soft and a 1px boundary border for 3:1 contrast (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: Frosted glass panel fill. Always paired with backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)) and glass-border.

tokens.name: glass-surface-strong
tokens.usage: Glass panel fill where legibility must win over transparency (modals, primary readouts).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on the top and left edge of every glass panel, simulating a refracted edge.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular highlight: a 1–2px gradient line along a glass panel's top edge.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind an elevated glass panel (modals, popovers).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary body and heading text on surface-base / surface-raised / glass-surface-strong (15:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on surface-base / glass-surface (7:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only.

tokens.name: accent-a
tokens.usage: Concept A (Instrument) primary accent fill — the one saturated color in an otherwise restrained palette.

tokens.name: accent-a-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-a fills.

tokens.name: accent-b
tokens.usage: Concept B (Atrium) primary accent fill for CTAs and active states.

tokens.name: accent-b-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-b fills.

tokens.name: accent-c
tokens.usage: Concept C (Aurora Console) primary accent fill for buttons and labels.

tokens.name: accent-c-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-c fills.

tokens.name: accent-c-glow
tokens.usage: Concept C decorative edge glow and large display numerals only — see violet-500's own note on the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Lucent's locked primary accent — indigo, carried from Concept A/Instrument. Used by the Primary Direction component and, as the panel case study's Secondary, by the panel case study.

tokens.name: accent-primary-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-primary fills.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Lucent's locked secondary accent — violet, carried from Concept C/Aurora Console. Used by the Primary Direction component and, as the panel case study's Primary, by the panel case study.

tokens.name: accent-secondary-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-secondary fills.

tokens.name: accent-tertiary
tokens.usage: Lucent's locked tertiary accent — the cyan already used inside Concept C's own design for its 'sync' state. Gradients and secondary marks only, same restraint as accent-b. Replaces the earlier invented green as the panel case study's tertiary.

tokens.name: accent-tertiary-on
tokens.usage: Text and icon color on accent-tertiary fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The only focus indicator color, independent of any concept's accent, so focus never reads as an accent color. 4.6:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: cyan-600
tokens.usage: Dark-surface chart-mark variant of cyan-500 — cyan-500 itself runs too light/low-chroma on the dark chart surface to pass the categorical lightness band; this step does. Not used outside data visualization.

tokens.name: viz-series-a
tokens.usage: Chart series slot A. Validated categorical (with viz-series-b, viz-series-c): CVD ΔE 15.8–19.6, normal-vision ΔE 21.4–25.7, both ≥3:1 on surface-base in both themes.

tokens.name: viz-series-b
tokens.usage: Chart series slot B. Light theme sits at 2.2:1 on surface-base — ship a legend and/or direct labels with it, never fill alone (validator relief rule).

tokens.name: viz-series-c
tokens.usage: Chart series slot C. Clears the categorical band and ≥3:1 contrast in both themes without adjustment.

tokens.name: viz-series-d
tokens.usage: Chart series slot D (4th categorical, rose; hue distinct from the status ladder). Contrast on surface-base 4.89:1 light / 5.70:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Reserved status color — healthy/low-severity. Always icon + label, never color alone. 3.98:1 / 9.06:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Reserved status color — needs attention. Always icon + label. 3.06:1 / 9.62:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Reserved status color — degraded, one step below critical. Always icon + label. 4.11:1 / 7.77:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Reserved status color — failing/highest severity. Also the color an inherently bad-vs-good series (an error count, a failure rate) wears in a chart, per the collision rule: status meaning beats categorical when a series IS the status. Always icon + label. 4.85:1 / 6.95:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Reserved status color — active/in-progress. Distinct from the good/warning/serious/critical severity ladder: this is an activity state, not a severity. Always icon + label. 5.92:1 / 5.26:1 on surface-base. Added for the panel case study.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The system name on the cover and full-bleed hero moments only.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section-opening numerals and large readouts (Concept C's console displays).

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Control cluster labels and list-row titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, secondary list content.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Instrument-panel tick labels and tags. Set uppercase in CSS, not stored in the token.

styles.name: panel-wordmark
styles.usage: The panel case-study wordmark only — Inter Black/ExtraBold, standing in for the case study's untokenized brand face.

styles.name: panel-display
styles.usage: Panel case study hero numerals and display-scale moments — Archivo Black is a single chunky weight, used sparingly.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel case study card and tile headings.

styles.name: panel-body-lg
styles.usage: Panel case study large body copy.

styles.name: panel-body
styles.usage: Panel case study default body copy.

styles.name: panel-small
styles.usage: Panel case study pills, row values, secondary content.

styles.name: panel-caption
styles.usage: Panel case study labels and timestamps.

textScale.name: text-scale
textScale.usage: User text-size multiplier. Hosts set html{font-size:calc(16px * var(--text-scale))}; all type tokens are rem so they follow. Control hit areas stay in px and do not scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tick spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight control padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default control padding; the cover's grid-pattern pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the base grid unit for layout.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between grouped controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page-level margins on wide layouts.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Concept A: switches, chips, tick marks — brutalist, barely-rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Concept A: buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Concept B: default card and button radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Concept B/C: large panels and modals.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Concept C: hero panels and console shells.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, dials and Concept C's disc motifs.

tokens.name: radius-squircle
tokens.usage: Percentage-based superellipse radius for app-icon-scale marks — the panel case study's radius geometry swatch.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-md for neumorphic controls.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-lg for neumorphic cards.

tokens.name: radius-well
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-md for recessed wells and fields.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Alias of radius-full for pills and toggles.

tokens.name: neu-raised
tokens.usage: Embossed elevation on surface-raised — buttons, dials, switches at rest. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

tokens.name: neu-inset
tokens.usage: Debossed/pressed elevation on surface-sunken — wells, tracks, active buttons. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

tokens.name: neu-inset-soft
tokens.usage: Softer debossed elevation for small, nested wells (concentric hub/marble motifs) where neu-inset reads as too high-contrast — most visibly in light theme, where a given shadow alpha is far more prominent against a near-white surface than the same alpha is against near-black. Discovered on the Orbital Pull mark (the LucentDS logo); use here in place of neu-inset for any small-radius debossed shell nested inside a larger raised surface. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-sm
tokens.usage: Small embossed elevation for chips and compact controls.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-md
tokens.usage: Rest elevation for neumorphic controls and cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-lg
tokens.usage: Large embossed elevation for hero panels and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover elevation for neumorphic controls.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Pressed or active elevation on surface-control and wells.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-soft
tokens.usage: Recessed field elevation for inputs on surface-field and surface-input.

tokens.name: elevation-resting
tokens.usage: Alias: rest elevation (same value as shadow-raised-md).

tokens.name: elevation-lifted
tokens.usage: Alias: lifted elevation (same value as shadow-raised-hover).

tokens.name: elevation-pressed
tokens.usage: Alias: pressed elevation (same value as shadow-inset).

tokens.name: elevation-field
tokens.usage: Alias: field elevation (same value as shadow-inset-soft).

tokens.name: glass-elevation-1
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for a single glass panel.

tokens.name: glass-elevation-2
tokens.usage: A glass panel floating over another layer — the mid parallax plane.

tokens.name: glass-elevation-3
tokens.usage: The nearest parallax plane — modals, the topmost card in a stack.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on small chips and tags.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on standard glass panels and cards.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on full-bleed glass surfaces and modals.

tokens.name: opacity-glass-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative glow washes and background gradients behind glass.

tokens.name: opacity-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass fills that must read as nearly-solid.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop dimming behind an elevated modal.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The system's one easing curve. No springs, no bounces, nothing decorative.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Press/tap feedback only — a button, toggle or switch moving to its neu-inset pressed state.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Everything else that transitions or animates — panel reveals, glass-surface entrances, hover states. There is deliberately no slower duration.

tokens.name: status-pulse
tokens.usage: Reserved for status-info ("active/in-progress") only, to distinguish it from a static severity dot. Not a general-purpose attention-getter.

rules: Every transition/animation must reference dur-fast, dur-base or ease-out — no ad hoc duration or easing values in component CSS.
Wrap all motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and disable or drastically shorten it there; this system has no motion that is load-bearing for comprehension.
